applies_to: Neptronic SKVF series evaporative coolers (also used for humidification).
summary: The SKVF is an evaporative media cooler that can control on humidity or temperature. Its controller provides BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP with selectable control profiles, network RH and temperature readings and setpoints, occupancy, operating state and alarms.
notes: Objects and their writable properties are taken from the guide's 'W?' column; Present_Value writable means the BMS can change it.
Units follow the BACnet Server Units setting (Metric or Imperial).

source.title: Evaporative Cooler SKVF Series BACnet Communication Module User Guide

integration.summary: Select a network control profile (MSV 28) or set MSV 43 to Network and write demand to AV 138; for internal control feed room RH (AV 106) or temperature (AV 155) with their setpoints. Switch the unit with MSV 83 and supervise BV 44.
integration.enable: MSV 83 System Power State is writable (1 = Off, 2 = On); the control source follows MSV 28 Control Profile or the individual source MSVs (43, 33, 76) with the Custom profile.
integration.heartbeat: AV 223 Network Timeout (1-900 s) sets how long the cooler tolerates loss of BACnet control communication before it stops; BV 44 Network Control State shows 1 = Fault.
integration.remote_sensors: Room RH to AV 106 (MSV 33 = Network), room temperature to AV 155 (MSV 76 = Network), setpoints AV 107-109 and AV 156-158; supply high limit RH AV 122 and temperature AV 175 with setpoints AV 123 and AV 176-178; direct demand AV 138.
setup: MS/TP MAC defaults to 1 (000-254; 128-254 are non-token-passing slaves); baud rate auto-detects (Auto, 9600, 19200, 38400, 76800); Max_Master 127.
Device instance defaults to 153000 + MAC (153001 out of the box) and can be changed from the menu or by writing Device Object_Identifier.
BACnet IP uses UDP 47808 (0xBAC0) by default.
Network/communication settings are in the controller's Integration menu (password 5544); power-cycle after connecting to the network.
Reinitialize Device (warm/cold reset) over BACnet uses the password 'nep'.
gotchas: MSV 'BACnet Server List Mode' chooses which objects are published (Integrator, Advanced, Factory); objects marked Advanced in the guide, such as the program objects, only show in Advanced mode.
Writing Out_of_Service = True disconnects an object from its physical input so the Present_Value can be overwritten; remember to set it back.
The unit signals alarms through object values only; it does not send BACnet event notifications, so poll or use COV.
COV subscriptions are lost on a power cycle.
Lower Max_Master to the highest MAC on the trunk to speed up MS/TP token passing.
